final_message: Implemented union resolution of register event files on integrate-merge conflicts (new src/register-event-merge.ts; wired into resolveBranchOwnedConflicts in src/exec-worktree-ops.ts). Merge-target-only events are kept, relinked in time order, and non-status events inherit the preceding status. The ticket is rebuilt from merge-target-only events for type/priority/owner/due. Other bookkeeping files (plan, result, pjr-index) still take the exec branch side, and a union that breaks status continuity falls back to the exec branch side with a log message. Added unit tests (tests/src/register-event-merge.test.ts) and an integration test (tests/src/exec-worktree-ops.integration.test.ts) showing that a waiting-time update event on the merge target survives integration. The integration test's ticket may merge without a conflict, so the ticket rebuild is verified only by the unit tests. Updated exec-worktree-guide.md and the PJR-36CN ticket work/result sections. Verified: prettier/eslint on changed TS, prettier/markdownlint/docs-lint on changed Markdown, catalog validate. Not verified in sandbox: none of the new tests or the typecheck were run here; typecheck and unit/integration tests are left to the parent runner. `specdojo index build` was not run because it rewrites protected .specdojo/doc-index.json, and `npm run check` (a ticket completion condition) was not run.
